pages.text: Free power, and not much of it: $(o)12 FE/t$() while it is daytime, not raining, and the block above it can see the sky.$(br2)It has no fuel slot, because it has nothing to eat. Put a row of them on a roof and run a cable back to a cell, and they will fill it over a few days.$(br2)Its buffer holds 40,000 FE and it gives out up to 200 FE/t.
